versions.changelog:
- Initial release of biweekly-work-report skill.
- Record daily work activities in categorized plain Markdown files stored locally at `~/.workbuddy/work-logs/`.
- Generate structured weekly, biweekly, or custom date range work reports from accumulated logs.
- Supports intelligent log parsing, categorization, and report summarization (重点工作/详细记录/下周计划/问题与风险).
- No servers or databases; all data remains local and editable with any text or code tool.
- Triggered by a range of work logging or report generation phrases.
